98060853.s: Keeps the old style of the traditional market, with a wide choice of handicrafts and agricultural products.
98060853.b: Mahayil Popular Market keeps the old style of the traditional market, with a wide choice of handicrafts and agricultural products. It is in a small town with mild winters and hot summers, and is a trusted place for fair prices on local products. Phone: 0559667486. Open from 6:00 am to 12:00 midnight.

98060852.s: In one of the old neighborhoods of Al Wadeen Governorate, with a wide choice of traditional clothing, toys and handicrafts.
98060852.b: Al Jumaa Market is in one of the old neighborhoods of Al Wadeen Governorate and offers a wide choice of traditional clothing, toys and handicrafts. It is known for selling fresh vegetables and fruit directly from farmers, especially on Fridays, which makes it a favorite destination for lovers of fresh local produce. Phone: 0533794157. Open from 8:00 am to 7:55 pm.

98060851.s: A historic treasure in the heart of Abha that shows the beauty of the region, surrounded by the authenticity and heritage of Aseer.
98060851.b: Bastat Al Qabil is a historic treasure in the heart of Abha that shows the beauty of the region, so you find yourself surrounded by the authenticity and heritage of Aseer and enjoy a rich historical experience with its towering architecture. It includes cafes, restaurants, antique shops and a pet store, with a symbolic entrance fee for adults and free entry for children, and narrow alleys that reflect authentic heritage architecture. It is best to visit in the evening to avoid crowds and heat.

98060850.s: In one of the old neighborhoods of Khamis Mushait, with a wide choice of daggers, jambiyas, antique weapons and handicrafts.
98060850.b: Al Khamis Market is in one of the old neighborhoods of Khamis Mushait and offers a wide choice of daggers, jambiyas, antique weapons and handicrafts. It is a small, specialized market that attracts collectors of heritage antiques, with shops offering good prices, especially from Pakistani and Bangladeshi sellers. Open from 8:00 am to 11:00 pm.

98060849.s: A space for varied shopping for everything you need, from local and imported products.
98060849.b: Al Balad Market offers a space for varied shopping for everything you need from local and imported products, and is one of the oldest markets in downtown Abha. It is known for the variety of its choices and reasonable prices, and attracts visitors looking for an authentic traditional shopping experience. Open from 9:00 am to 12:00 midnight.

98060848.s: One of the best shopping centers in Abha, with many international brands and cafes and wide plazas decorated with fountains.
98060848.b: Lavanda Park is one of the best shopping centers in Abha, with many international brands and cafes and wide plazas decorated with fountains. It is strategically located between Abha and Khamis Mushait near the airport and has an Extra hypermarket and a variety of fashion shops, making it an elegant destination that stays in visitors' memories. Phone: 0920009467. Open from 9:00 am to 12:00 midnight.
98060848.a: King Fahd Road, Al Mazwin, Abha 62583

98060847.s: A contemporary design like a different city, with a dancing fountain at its center, seating and shopping areas, plus restaurants and cafes.
98060847.b: KM Boulevard has a contemporary design like a different city, with a dancing fountain at its center and places to sit and shop, plus a variety of restaurants and cafes. It combines beauty, entertainment and relaxation in wide modern spaces and hosts seasonal events and activities for families and individuals. Open from 7:30 am to 12:00 midnight.

98060846.s: A distinctive shopping center in the region with many brands, a children's play area and a great Indian restaurant.
98060846.b: Oasis Centre is a distinctive shopping center in the region, with many brands such as Centrepoint, Max and Ounass, as well as a great Indian restaurant. It offers a children's play area, a prayer room and a rest area, and has organized, spacious parking, making it a practical choice for everyday shopping. Phone: 0583192370. Open from 9:00 am to 12:00 midnight.
98060846.a: King Fahd Road, Al Manhal, Abha 62521

98060844.s: A distinctive family shopping center with many brands, international cafes and a children's play area.
98060844.b: Asdaf Mall is a distinctive family shopping center, with many brands and international cafes and a children's play area on the second floor. It has a well-equipped dining area, although some sections need more activity to attract more visitors, especially on the upper floors.

98060843.s: One of the newest shopping centers in the region, with many options for shopping, games and cinema.
98060843.b: Mujan Park is one of the newest shopping centers in the region, with many options for shopping, games and cinema, and it is constantly refreshed with new brands. It is known for providing everything under one roof in an elegant atmosphere, although some visitors note that parking is tight at peak times. Phone: 0920035121. Open from 8:00 am to 1:00 am.

98060841.s: A distinctive shopping center in the region with international brands, shopping options, children's games, restaurants and cafes.
98060841.b: Al Khamis Avenue is a distinctive shopping center in Khamis Mushait, with international brands such as H&M, Mothercare and MAC, many shopping options, children's games, and a variety of restaurants and cafes. It has a spacious layout and good parking, and is a popular evening destination for shopping lovers in the governorate. Open from 9:30 am to 12:00 midnight.
98060841.a: King Khalid Road, Al Dhalalah, Khamis Mushait 62411

98060840.s: A family destination with a selection of major brands, restaurants, cafes, a cinema and a children's play area.
98060840.b: Al Rashid Mall is one of the leading family destinations in Abha, with a wide selection of major brands such as Zara and H&M, restaurants and cafes, a cinema and a large children's play area. It is well organized with multi-level parking and is one of the most dependable destinations for shopping and family entertainment in the region. Phone: 0530246140. Open from 9:00 am to 11:00 pm.
98060840.a: King Fahd Road, Al Badie, Abha 62581

98060794.s: Features many kinds of flowers and roses, and includes a bird sanctuary where you can enjoy a calm rural atmosphere.
98060794.b: Ghusn Rural Farm features many kinds of flowers and roses and includes a bird sanctuary where you can enjoy a calm rural atmosphere. It is a spacious place that combines a restaurant, a buffet and a cafe, so you can spend a long time without getting bored, in a relaxing rural setting that lifts the spirits. Phone: 0562654481. Open from 6:00 am to 10:00 pm.

98060793.s: See the stages of growing strawberries through to ripeness, and buy products made from strawberries.
98060793.b: AlTurki Strawberry Farm lets you see the stages of growing strawberries through to ripeness, and sells some products made from strawberries, such as dried figs. It is a wonderful experience for children, who enjoy picking strawberries and tasting them fresh with chocolate, at reasonable prices and in a friendly atmosphere. Phone: 0552548800. Open from 9:00 am to 10:00 pm.

98060792.s: One of the best farms, with green spaces and a variety of flowers around, a mix of seating areas and kiosks selling food and refreshments.
98060792.b: Al Athiriyah Farm is one of the best farms, with green spaces and a variety of flowers around, a mix of seating areas, and kiosks selling food and refreshments. It is in Bisha, and the entrance fee is symbolic (15 riyals per person). The atmosphere is calm and suits relaxation more than children's entertainment activities. Phone: 0558268572. Open from 6:00 am to 2:00 am.

98060791.s: Enjoy the scent of natural Taif rose and its beautiful form at Al Thamarat Farm.
98060791.b: Al Thamarat Taifi Rose Farm lets you enjoy the scent of natural Taif rose and its beautiful form in a lovely rural setting. It is a miniature version of Taif's famous rose fields, suitable for photography lovers and anyone looking for a fragrant rural atmosphere. Phone: 0500550884.

98060790.s: A farm specialized in making honey, where you can see the stages of honey making and the varieties, and buy the finest honey.
98060790.b: Al Almaei Apiaries Farm specializes in making honey, where you can see the stages of honey making and its varieties, and buy the finest natural honey. The place ships honey products to all regions of the Kingdom, and its products have excellent reviews for purity and quality of taste. Phone: 0532980597. Open from 8:00 am to 12:00 midnight.

98060788.s: A distinctive experience of picking strawberries directly or enjoying their juice and some dishes made from them.
98060788.b: Sahab Al Saqa Strawberry Farm offers a distinctive experience of picking strawberries directly or enjoying their juice and some dishes made from them. It has excellent reviews from families for the quality of its fresh strawberries and the friendliness of its staff, and is a fun destination where children enjoy picking their own fruit. Phone: 0551752209. Open from 9:30 am to 6:30 pm.

98060786.s: Enjoy picking and buying strawberries, or drink fresh strawberry juice.
98060786.b: The Strawberry Farm (Al Sahab) lets you enjoy picking and buying strawberries or drinking fresh strawberry juice. It opens to visitors around 10 am to view the farm, with actual picking from 1 pm, and entry is completely free. Phone: 0551900766. Open from 1:00 pm to 7:30 pm.

98060784.s: Quiet walking tracks suitable for different kinds of sport, with seating areas and other activities.
98060784.b: Alrawda Park has quiet walking tracks suitable for different kinds of sport, with seating areas and other activities. It includes shops and local products such as tahini halva, strawberry cups and mifa bread, and it opens from 4 pm to 2 am, making it a calm, well-organized evening destination.
98060784.a: Al Ghulaith Villages, Sir Al Ghalid, Abha 62586

98060783.s: Located in Al Muwazzafin District, with a walking track, playgrounds and a cycling path next to green lawns for sitting and enjoying.
98060783.b: Lasan Valley Park is located in Al Muwazzafin District and has a walking track, playgrounds and a cycling path next to green lawns for sitting and relaxing. It is notable for its straight track without tiring slopes, with food carts along the walkway, a prayer room and restrooms, which makes it one of the best parks in Abha.
98060783.a: Al Muwazzafin District, Al Mazwin, Abha 62583

98060781.s: One of the oldest parks in the region, a good place for families because of its proximity to many restaurants.
98060781.b: Andalus Park is one of the oldest parks in the region and a good place for families because it is close to many restaurants. It is known for its beautiful jacaranda trees and a colorful art wall in the background, and is sometimes covered in mist, which gives it an enchanting character, although wandering flower-garland sellers can occasionally be a minor nuisance.

98060780.s: One of the large parks in the region, with a walkway, a sitting garden, places selling coffee and food, and children's games.
98060780.b: Million's Park is one of the large parks in the region, with a walkway, a sitting garden, places selling coffee and food, and children's games. It is known for its fun little train ride for children (10 riyals per ride), alongside various shops for toys, ice cream and perfumes, which makes it a favorite destination on cool summer evenings.

98060760.s: One of the distinctive parks in the region, decorated with fountains, with children's games, wide green spaces and a specialty cafe.
98060760.b: Al Salam Park is one of the distinctive parks in the region, decorated with fountains and with children's games, wide green spaces and a specialty cafe. It has many large trees and friendly cats and offers a calm morning atmosphere suited to families, although the play area is sometimes closed at certain times. Open from 6:30 am to 11:45 am.

98060758.s: Several wide walking tracks, with seating for families, children's games and football and volleyball fields.
98060758.b: Almashhad Park has several wide walking tracks, with seating for families, children's games and football and volleyball fields. It is considered one of the best community parks in Abha because of the length of its walking track, and it suits long outings, although it is sometimes crowded in the evening.
